The mark crosses the plan into the printer, the lamp answers, the ticket prints and the cook starts the wok. The owner's $9,650 is stamped OWNER COUNT beside an empty RECEIPTS clip. Coins fill the jar under FOX 26. The rule card shows cooks in a pool only without a tip credit, and the folder's box stays blank. An older customer's phone can't lock on the code beside one customer's quote. The panel takes the next order, its ticket prints, and the jar ends under owner says and no record shown.
story_review.opening_to_ending: The opening question (who takes the order now that the server is gone) is answered when the panel takes the order and its own ticket prints (54.17 s on). The close holds the jar under owner says and no record shown, which keeps the tip claim on the owner's word without inventing an outcome. That chain is earned once s2 tells the truth about how the job was handled.
